title: Chereze family wins death certificate after legal battle

tellings.quote: After a protracted legal battle, the family finally received the death certificate.

plain: After a long legal fight, the family of a man named Marco Chereze finally got his death certificate, issued through a laboratory called IPD. The filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this, crediting a researcher named Roger Leir and a woman named Marta. It matters because the episode ties Chereze's death to the army's reported capture of a living creature in Varginha, Brazil, in 1996, and the certificate could say what killed him.
